test_title: PYST 112: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 16 Jan, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’.

If C ÷ D @ E × F – G, how is C related to G?
solution:
The pattern followed here is.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

**Given: **

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/225d1a0c946ccd0591eac3fff4e4130b469094d3169ddcaa63f3bdc15abd6d08.png] 

Clearly, C is the sister of G.

Hence the correct answer is "Sister".
